messages:
maya (PM): Quick thread — we need to triage Optimize recommendations roadmap after customer calls this week. Key asks: actionable quant recs, batch-sizing heuristics, eval-triggered regression alerts. Can we sketch a phased plan?

dylan (Eng): We can get read-only advisor recs + SDK hints out fastest. Auto-tune requires runtime hooks (KV/cache control) and rollout infra.

sujal (ML): From model side: quant recs need per-model calibration (throughput vs perf curves). If we reuse existing perf harness, ~2w per model to collect initial data.

liz (SE): Customer asks include autopilot tuning (auto-apply quant/batching) + rollout controls. They require audit logs and easy opt-out.

raj (CS): Heads-up: Acme pilot wants eval-alerts tied to specific prompt sets and ability to route alerts to Splunk/PagerDuty. Need a stable alert payload schema.

maya (PM): Proposal: Phase 1 (MVP) = non-invasive advisor + eval-alerts (signal-only, no auto-apply). Phase 2 = guided autotune (operator approves suggested changes). Phase 3 = automatic policy enforcement (Dedicated/private only).

dylan (Eng): Rough eng constraints: Phase1 -> read-only + alerts + dashboards. Phase2 -> A/B rollout support, traffic mirroring, feature flags. Phase3 -> safe auto-apply with revert. Eng estimates: 6w / 8-10w / 6w respectively.

sujal (ML): Suggested launch criteria for Phase1: 1) `optimize.recs_precision >= 0.85` on benchmark prompt set, 2) eval-alert false positive rate < 2/wk on pilot customers, 3) docs + SDK examples shipped.

liz (SE): Core metrics to expose: `optimize.cost_savings_pct`, `optimize.latency_p50`, `eval.alert_rate`, `recs.accept_rate`. Need per-customer cohorts and baseline comparisons.

maya (PM): Customer gating: need pilot commitments from 2 customers (Acme, Nova) for Phase1 sign-up. With both signed we can shift prioritization.

raj (CS): Security/blockers: KMS integration for private deployments before auto-apply, RBAC for who can approve/rollout, audit trail format.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created tracking ticket #OPT-3124 for Phase1 MVP. :white_check_mark:

dylan (Eng): Risk notes: 1) accuracy regressions, 2) infra load from calibration jobs, 3) UX confusion if recs are ambiguous. Mitigations: canary by route, strict quotas, clear explanations + one-click revert. :warning:

maya (PM): Action items: dylan -> draft Phase1 tech spec by Mon (2123540000); sujal -> perf-harness plan; liz -> pilot onboarding checklist; raj -> security checklist (KMS/RBAC). Sync Fri 09:30. :calendar:
